hero.title: Dubai property advice built around your family’s future.
hero.lead: Evidence-led guidance. Relationship-led access. One accountable advisor, backed by Caspian Properties since 2007.

intro.title: Clarity before property.
intro.p1: Dubai offers an extraordinary range of property opportunities. The challenge is knowing which one belongs in your plan.
intro.p2: I combine market evidence, long-standing relationships and one accountable advisory process to help you decide with clarity — from first conversation to handover and beyond.
intro.p3: I work especially closely with Persian-speaking and internationally mobile families who want more than a project pitch.

method.title: Four stages. One accountable advisor.
method.lead: We begin with your objective, timeline and risk profile. Property options come after the brief.

services.title: Advice for the decision in front of you
services.lead: Each service starts with your brief. Inventory comes later — and only when it fits.

legacy.title: A personal advisor, backed by a Dubai brokerage legacy.
legacy.body: Clients trust a person, but they also need the reassurance of a licensed, established business. I am your visible, accountable advisor. Caspian Properties Brokers LLC — licensed in Dubai since 2007 — provides the continuity, developer relationships and systems behind my work.

lenses.title: Two lenses, one decision
lenses.lead: Major property decisions are rarely made alone. I make sure both perspectives are answered on the same page.
lenses.capitalQuestions: What is the downside? What makes this liquid? Why this option and not the alternative? What is the developer’s record?
lenses.familyQuestions: Is the location liveable? What is the community like? How will schooling, access, handover and day-to-day use work?
lenses.closing: The right property is the one that fits the capital, the timeline and the life behind both.

invite.title: Start with a private conversation
invite.body: Share a few details about your goals, then choose a time that suits you. Your information is used only to prepare for our conversation.
invite.response: Nadia or her team will reply within one business day.

discover.title: Discover
discover.summary: Goals, family context, constraints and time horizon.
discover.detail: We clarify the objective, budget, timeline, risk tolerance, intended use, liquidity needs and who is involved in the decision. No project is recommended before the brief is agreed.

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.summary: Market fit, risks, trade-offs and suitable strategies.
diagnose.detail: I determine which strategy and locations fit the brief — off-plan, ready, income, growth, end use, or a deliberate decision to wait — and explain the market context and constraints.
diagnose.output: A strategy note and comparison criteria

decide.title: Decide
decide.detail: We build a disciplined shortlist and compare fit, developer record, payment structure, total cost, risk, lifestyle and exit considerations. You see the reason behind every recommendation.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.summary: Coordinate the transaction and support the next steps.
deliver.detail: I coordinate reservation, required checks, documents, transaction parties, updates, handover and the agreed post-purchase plan. Compliance requests are explained early and handled through approved company processes.
deliver.output: A transaction roadmap and milestone updates

offPlan.name: Off-plan advisory
offPlan.question: Is buying before completion right for our timeline and capital?
offPlan.body: Compare developer track record, payment plan, total cost and handover risk before committing to a launch.

resale.name: Resale advisory
resale.question: Should we buy a ready property now?
resale.body: Assess value, condition, service charges, liquidity and exit options for completed homes and investments.

leasing.name: Leasing advisory
leasing.question: Where should we rent — or how should we let our property?
leasing.body: Brief-led guidance for tenants and landlords, with every step of the leasing process explained.

holidayHome.name: Holiday-home investment advisory
holidayHome.question: Could a property work as a holiday home?
holidayHome.body: Evaluate location, costs, permits and realistic income assumptions before you buy. My role is purchase advice; letting and operation sit with separately licensed providers.

Approach.title: Clarity before property.
Approach.lead: I understand your objectives, constraints and decision dynamics before presenting inventory. Every recommendation includes the reason it fits, the material risks, the evidence behind it and the next sensible step.
Approach.evidenceLead: Any claim about price, yield, supply, payment plan, handover or developer performance should show:

evidence.type: Whether the number is asking, registered, forecast or illustrative
evidence.scope: The relevant geography and property type
evidence.assumptions: Any assumption that materially affects the conclusion

principles.urgency: Manufacture urgency or countdowns to push a decision.
principles.exclusive: Call access “exclusive” unless exclusivity is documented.
principles.publish: Publish your name, image, property or transaction without your specific written permission.

Approach.quote: Every number needs a source. Every recommendation needs a reason.

JourneyPage.title: From first brief to handover — and beyond.
JourneyPage.lead: One accountable advisor through every stage. This is the path you can expect.
JourneyPage.note: This describes the experience you can expect. It is not a substitute for legal or brokerage compliance procedures.
JourneyPage.privacyBody: At first contact I ask only for what is needed to prepare our conversation. This website never asks for passports, identity documents or financial statements.

pitch.q: Is the first consultation a sales pitch?
pitch.a: No. The first conversation is about your objectives, constraints and timeline. Property options come after we agree the brief — and sometimes the right advice is to wait.

abroad.q: Can we work together from outside the UAE?
abroad.a: Yes. Much of the advisory process can be handled remotely, with one accountable advisor and structured updates across time zones.

languages.q: Which languages do you advise in?

documents.q: What will you ask me for, and when?
documents.a: At first contact, only the basics needed to prepare our conversation. Identity and compliance documents are requested later, explained in advance, and handled through approved company processes.

otherAdvice.q: Do you provide legal, tax or mortgage advice?
otherAdvice.a: No. Where independent legal, tax, mortgage or immigration advice is needed, I will say so clearly and refer you appropriately.

publication.q: Will you publish anything about me or my purchase?
publication.a: Never without your specific written permission for that exact use.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.intro: This notice explains what information this website collects, why, and how it is handled. It describes how the website is actually set up.
Privacy.whoBody: This website is operated for Nadia Fallah, Real Estate Advisor, and Caspian Properties Brokers LLC, a real estate brokerage licensed in Dubai (commercial licence 595102). To ask about your information, please use the details on our <link>contact page</link>.
Privacy.collectBody: When you request a consultation, we collect the details you enter: your name, email address, phone number (if you choose phone or WhatsApp contact), where you are based, your preferred language and contact channel, your property interest, purpose, approximate budget range, decision timeline, who else is involved in the decision, any notes you add, and how you heard about Nadia. We also record the page you came from, campaign tags in the link you used (if any), the website language you used, and the date, time and version of the consent you gave.
Privacy.notCollected: We do not ask for passports, identity documents, bank details or financial statements through this website.
Privacy.useBody: To respond to your enquiry, prepare for and hold your consultation, and follow up as you agreed. We do not sell your information or use it for unrelated marketing.

services.supabase: Supabase stores your consultation request in a private database.
services.cal: Cal.com shows available times and manages your booking, confirmation, rescheduling and cancellation. When you book, Cal.com receives the details you enter in its booking form.
services.vercel: Vercel hosts this website and provides visitor statistics that do not use cookies.
services.upstash: Upstash briefly stores a one-way (hashed) form of your IP address to limit repeated submissions and prevent spam. These records expire automatically.

Privacy.servicesNote: These providers may process information outside the UAE.
Privacy.cookiesBody: This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. When the scheduling calendar loads, Cal.com may use cookies or similar storage that booking needs to work. While you fill in the consultation form, your answers are kept in your browser for the current session only, so they are not lost if you change language or reload; they are removed when you submit the form or close the tab.
Privacy.retentionBody: We keep enquiry and booking records only as long as needed for the purposes above and to meet the brokerage’s legal and regulatory obligations. Rate-limiting records expire within 24 hours.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your information, or withdraw your consent, at any time by contacting us. Withdrawing consent does not affect anything done before you withdrew it.
Privacy.securityBody: Consultation records are kept in access-controlled systems and are available only to Nadia and authorised Caspian Properties staff who need them.
Privacy.changesBody: If the way we handle information changes, we will update this notice and the date shown above.
